# Phase 31 — Independent Slice Verification

Use verification-engineer without modifying implementation. Verify each AC against approved contracts and the actual implementation. Run or inspect exact tests as permitted. Record PASS/FAIL/NOT RUN/BLOCKED with build/commit, environment and evidence. Check positive/negative/boundary/failure/retry/idempotency paths, logs and data integrity. Create defects for failures. A green unit test alone does not prove the whole AC. Do not mark slice complete without evidence.
